Subject: Yup. Me again. Seeking donations for the departed (soon-to-be) 
 
Greetings everyone!
It’s your friendly Free Press bill collector here, soliciting donations for our latest round of departing employees who have opted to take an early retirement.
These folks have been with us for years, some decades --  Patty, Sylvia, Cassandra, Holly, Diane, Julian, Tom, Lori and Gina -- so lets send them off with some nice gifts.
Feel free to leave donations at my desk, in a drawer, or under my keyboard.
We will give them their gifts in the newsroom on their last day, which is next Friday, Dec. 18.
p.s. Don’t forget  we’re having a party for them as well.
Where: Firebird Tavern, 419 Monroe Ave, Detroit When: Tuesday, December 15
Food: Chicken Caccitiore, Chesse Tortelini, chicken wings, glazed meatballs, and more!
Drink: Soft drinks are free. Hard stuff is not.
